subject: On-prem deployment — environment go/no-go health scan and preflight
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Nair <aisha.nair@solsticelabs.com>, ops@solsticelabs.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: On-prem deployment — environment go/no-go health scan and preflight

Hi Aisha / Solstice ops team —

We're scheduled to proceed with the private deployment smoke window on Friday 30 Jul between 02:00–04:00 PDT. Before we sign off for cutover we need a short health scan to confirm the environment meets the minimal preflight criteria below. I attached the updated network diagram and the preflight matrix for your convenience. Please reply inline with statuses.

High-level preflight checklist (please mark: OK / NEEDS ACTION / N/A and short note):
- Network peering/VPN: tunnel established, BGP routes accepted, propagation observed
- Egress IPs: static list for allowlisting (for telemetry and license calls)
- Firewall: inbound ports for inference control plane (TLS 443) and port 50051 for gRPC, plus SSH bastion port (22) to allowed IPs
- NAT and routing: NAT gateway for model updates + outbound to our telemetry endpoints
- DNS: private DNS zones and RECORDS pointing at internal load balancer
- TLS certs: certs uploaded to the load balancer; cert chain validated
- Service account / IAM: service principal created with keys rotated and placed in vault; minimum privileges granted
- KMS integration: customer KMS key accessible from our runtime instances for model key unseal
- Logs/telemetry: forwarding to our collector endpoint (TLS) and retention policy identified
- Storage access: S3-compatible endpoint reachable from worker nodes (read/write checks)
- Smoke traffic: sample tokenized requests validated with expected latencies; who will run these?

Asks from Redwood: please confirm availability of a Solstice engineer to join the 15-minute handover call 30 minutes prior to the window for the final checklist and one engineer on-call during the window.

Attachments: network-diagram-v2.pdf (application/pdf), preflight-matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Thanks — aiming for a clean, low-risk rollout.

—
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer\Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0173
From: Aisha Nair <aisha.nair@solsticelabs.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 11:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: On-prem deployment — environment go/no-go health scan and preflight

Thanks Mateo — quick answers inline. See also attached CSV with our egress IPs.

> Network peering/VPN:
OK — IPsec tunnel is up; we see BGP sessions established and routes for 10.200.0.0/16 learned. No flaps in the past 48h.

> Egress IPs:
OK — attaching solstice-egress-ips.csv; these are static from our NAT cluster.

> Firewall inbound ports:
NEEDS ACTION — port 50051 is currently blocked by default; we can open to your load balancer IPs but need the exact CIDR list you will use for workers. SSH to bastion is allowed from our security team IPs; provide the jumpbox public key for your engineers please.

> NAT and routing:
OK — outbound to our telemetry endpoints allowed; NAT translation logs look clean.

> DNS private zones:
OK — private zone created; ALIAS record for rl-inference.internal -> lb.internal.solstice.local added.

> TLS certs:
NEEDS ACTION — cert chain uploaded but OCSP stapling not enabled on the load balancer. We recommend enabling before traffic begins.

> Service account / IAM:
OK — service principal created; key material placed in a customer vault (we confirm access on your side required).

> KMS integration:
OK — test decrypts succeeded from a staging worker; please confirm production KMS ARN we should point at.

> Logs/telemetry:
OK — collector endpoint reachable (443). Retention: 90 days default; can adjust on request.

> Storage access:
OK — S3 bucket rw; 1MB roundtrip write/read test completed.

> Smoke traffic:
We can run the sample tokenized requests. Recommended: Redwood triggers initial smoke (10 requests) and we monitor for 5–10 minutes.

Attachments: solstice-egress-ips.csv (text/csv)

Let us know the CIDR list for worker egress and we will open 50051 for the limited IPs. We can also enable OCSP stapling today if that helps.

Regards,
Aisha Nair
Senior Cloud Engineer\Solstice Labs
aisha.nair@solsticelabs.com
+1 (206) 555-0199
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aisha Nair <aisha.nair@solsticelabs.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: On-prem deployment — environment go/no-go health scan and preflight

Thanks Aisha — good progress. Two technical clarifications from the runtime side:

1) Worker egress CIDR: we will be using the dedicated worker NAT range 3.21.44.0/24 for this account during the rollout and 3.21.45.0/24 for any burst traffic. Please only allow the first /24 for the smoke test; we'll confirm burst windows in advance.

2) Port 50051: we use 50051 for internal gRPC between our control-plane proxy and the inference workers. For the smoke window I'd prefer the LB to accept 443 and proxy to 50051 internally, but if Solstice prefers direct 50051 inbound we can add a short-term exception. Which is simpler for you?

3) Bastion access: we'll provide a new jumpbox public key (ssh-rsa AAAA...) to your security team before 18:00 PDT today. Please confirm the allowed source IPs for the bastion so we can schedule remote engineers.

If Aisha can enable OCSP stapling today and open 3.21.44.0/24 to port 50051 (or let us know if LB proxying is preferred) we can mark the firewall item OK.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Customer Onboarding\Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aisha Nair <aisha.nair@solsticelabs.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: On-prem deployment — environment go/no-go health scan and preflight

Quick ops plan to close the loop:

- I will upload the jumpbox key before 18:00 PDT today and confirm in this thread when it's live.
- Mateo/Ben: run the 10-request smoke from the staging runner at 01:30 PDT Friday (30 Jul) and share traces in the monitoring channel.
- Solstice: if you can open 3.21.44.0/24 to port 50051 or confirm that LB TLS termination + internal proxying is acceptable, we will proceed.
- I will enable OCSP stapling on the load balancer during the maintenance window if Solstice gives thumbs up; otherwise we will postpone the window.

Runbook reference: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d-preflight (see "runbook-smoke.md").

Attachments referenced: runbook-smoke.md (text/markdown)

If all items marked OK by 20:00 PDT tonight, Mateo will send the final cutover confirmation and we will proceed with the 02:00–04:00 PDT window on Friday.

Thanks — K
Kimberly Park
Lead Onboarding Engineer\Redwood Inference
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Nair <aisha.nair@solsticelabs.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: On-prem deployment — environment go/no-go health scan and preflight (final)

All — thanks for the fast responses. Summary and go/no-go:

- Egress CIDR confirmed: 3.21.44.0/24 — Solstice will open port 50051 to this /24 for the smoke test (Aisha confirmed).
- OCSP stapling: Solstice will enable during the maintenance window (OK).
- Jumpbox key: Kimberly will upload and confirm (in progress).
- KMS: production ARN to point at is arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/prod-rl-01 (Ben / infra please validate).
- Smoke traffic: Redwood runs 10 requests at 01:30 PDT on Friday; Solstice watches telemetry for 10 minutes.

I consider this a conditional GO for the Friday window provided the firewall exception and jumpbox key are confirmed by 20:00 PDT tonight. If any of those items are outstanding by then we will pause the rollout and reschedule.

Final approvers: Aisha (Solstice ops) and Ben/Kimberly (Redwood ops). Please reply "ACK" in thread when you have the final confirmations so I can send the docu-sign and the cutover calendar invite.

—
